1-settings-1.tsx.notes: No layout problems: shrink-wrapped Columns inside SingleChildScrollView, Expanded only inside Rows, Container has decoration alongside clipBehavior; the number is passed to Text as a numeric JSX child rather than a string.

1-settings-2.tsx.notes: State lives inside each ToggleRow/TextSizeRow instance, so toggles are independent; Columns with default mainAxisSize max in the unbounded scroll axis just shrink-wrap since they have no flex children.

1-settings-3.tsx.notes: No layout problems; the number is passed to Text as a numeric JSX child rather than a string, and the slider is inset only 4px while the label row is inset 16px (cosmetic).
